g.text: ResQ-Vision / 03 Rear motors and encoder translation
PROVISIONAL CANDIDATES - confirm class hardware before wiring
Native module symbols / named nets / no PCB footprints / Rev P1 / 2026-10-19
Pololu 4865 encoder requires 3.5-20V and outputs 0..VCC: use 5V supply and U4 translation, never direct to ESP.
U4 is 5V-input tolerant at 3.3V supply. Use a breakout/adapter; pin numbers refer to TI SOIC-14.
Motor candidate: 12V MP, 47:1 nominal, 48 CPR on motor shaft, 1.8A extrapolated stall each.
Wheel diameter, direction signs, quadrature counting and speed/current limits need physical calibration.
Motor supply and encoder supply are different nets. Keep encoder cable away from motor switching wiring.
